text:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — Acme onboarding: they signed off on functional tests but we're still missing the SLO evidence bundle for latency p95. Their renewal review is next Tuesday, need this compiled by Monday EOD.
Ben (Infra): On it. Can you confirm the target? I have 150ms p95 for the hosted API in the contract but the onboarding doc mentions 120ms in a couple places.
Maya (CSM): Contracted is p95 <= 150ms for text-generation endpoints (see clause 3.2). The 120ms line is an internal recommendation from Enablement, ignore for credits. We'll communicate 150ms to the customer.
Olga (Product): Re: evidence bundle — we should include: 1) synthetic load test results with client trace IDs, 2) a 72h production latency slice, 3) any incidents that might have impacted measurement windows, and 4) the canary config used during onboarding.
Sam (SRE): I can export 72h percentiles from observability. Which time window do we use? Acme's onboarding traffic ramp started 2026-03-10 at 10:00 UTC. Use the first 72h from ramp start?
Maya (CSM): Yes, first 72h post-ramp. Also include request volume and sample rate so they can see statistical significance.
Ben (Infra): Do we need raw traces or can we provide aggregated p50/p95/p99 + a few representative traces? Legal asked for 'sufficient evidence' — better to include both summaries and 3-5 raw traces for audits.
Olga (Product): Add a one-page explanation of measurement methodology: how we calculate client-observed latency vs. server processing, whether retries excluded, and if caching prefix hits were counted.
Sam (SRE): Note: our observability has request_type tags. For text-generation we need to filter on model:name=redwood-gen-3 and route=/v1/generate, otherwise percentile mix is noisy.
Maya (CSM): Good call. Ben — can you assemble the synthetic test artifacts? I remember we ran a k6 job earlier. If you can export the k6 output + script, that helps reproducibility.
Ben (Infra): Copy of k6 script and JSON output: I'll attach to the bundle. Also will include the JMeter bucketed histogram we used during the last dedicated run.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-11T02:12Z — rolled redwood-gen-3@v3.1.2 to hosted-cluster-3 (no failures). :white_check_mark:
Sam (SRE): Small risk flag: there was a 5min network flap on 2026-03-11 02:40Z in cluster-3, which bumped p95 for ~6min. I'll annotate the 72h window and provide a version excluding the 6min incident for fairness.
Maya (CSM): Perfect — document both: raw window and incident-excluded window. Customer expects transparency.
Olga (Product): Also include the configuration we recommended for their Dedicated POC (batching=dynamic, kv_cache=true, quant_profile=aq4). That way they see the delta between hosted numbers and what Dedicated might yield.
Ben (Infra): Timeline: I can push the bundle to Google Drive by Monday 14:00 PST. Sam — can you upload the observability CSVs and the annotated incident log by then?
Sam (SRE): Yes, I'll upload CSVs + short notes on how we filtered traces by client IP and route.
Maya (CSM): I'll draft the cover email and the SLO summary (one pager) for execs. Olga — can you review the methodology paragraph by EOD Monday?
Olga (Product): Yep, will review first thing Monday.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. After we share, I'll ask Acme if they want a walkthrough call Thurs to go through the bundle. If they push for latency credits, we already agreed to use the contract p95 window and standard credit calculation.
Ben (Infra): One more: include a short reproducibility note with the exact k6 command we ran, e.g.:
```
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 5m --out json=acme_k6.json acme_slo_test.js
```
That helps auditors.
Sam (SRE): And include the sample rate setting we used in prod tracing: sample_rate=0.2.
Maya (CSM): Got it. I'll create the Drive folder and add a checklist. Tagging this thread for visibility. :spiral_calendar:
Olga (Product): :thumbsup:
Ben (Infra): :white_check_mark:
Sam (SRE): Uploaded CSVs to the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example/acme-slo-evidence (will DM access).
Maya (CSM): Folder link received. Closing loop — I'll send the cover email Monday 16:00 PST with the bundle attached and a suggested slot for the walkthrough. Thanks all.
